普通对话、插件和 App 自身的通知等功能不需要 ADB。

ADB 用于助手执行受支持的 Android 设备命令，例如查看应用与系统状态、读取有限日志、操作允许目录内的文件。所有命令仍需通过 DSHA 策略检查；开启 ADB 不会放开静默装卸应用、修改系统设置或刷机。

短信查询需在「设置 → 设备能力授权」中预授权，或逐次确认。屏幕点击与输入使用下方的屏幕操作权限。

使用无线配对需要 Android 11+ 的「无线调试」功能；部分厂商可能限制。更低版本可在可用时使用 Shizuku，或继续使用无需 ADB 的功能。
en:
Regular conversations, plugins and DSHA notifications do not require ADB.

ADB lets the assistant run supported Android device commands, such as inspecting app and system status, reading limited logs and working with files in allowed directories. Every command must still pass DSHA's policy checks. Enabling ADB does not allow silent app installation or removal, system setting changes or firmware flashing.

SMS queries require preauthorization in Settings → Device permissions or confirmation for each query. Screen taps and typing use the screen-control permission below.

Wireless pairing requires Android 11+ Wireless debugging and may be restricted by your device manufacturer. On older versions, use Shizuku where available or continue using features that do not require ADB.

zh: 自动模式保留 IPv6，仅在 Node 双栈解析失败时尝试 IPv4。IPv4 兼容模式适用于拒绝 AAAA 查询的网络，但无法解析仅有 IPv6 的域名。保存后重新启动 Web 或新建终端生效。
en: Automatic mode preserves IPv6 and retries IPv4 only when Node dual-stack DNS fails. IPv4 compatibility helps networks that reject AAAA queries, but cannot resolve IPv6-only domains. Save, then restart Web or open a new terminal.

zh: 管理器已安装，服务尚未连接。点击授权重新连接；若仍未连接，请启动管理器服务，并检查隐藏模式是否允许 DSHA。
en: Manager installed, service not connected. Tap Authorize to reconnect. If it still fails, start the service in the manager and check whether hidden mode allows DSHA.

zh: 使用 bxroot 运行时（实验）
LD_PRELOAD 方案的实验运行时；不兼容时请改用 proroot 或 proot。保存并重启 Web 后生效。
en: Experimental LD_PRELOAD runtime. Switch to proroot or proot if incompatible. Save and restart the Web service to apply.
